meta.descPinball: Play free 3D pinball online with no download: launch the ball, flip it up the table, hit the bumpers and light the lanes for a score multiplier. Three balls, ball save, works on phones.

pinball.name: Pinball
pinball.blurb: Flip, bump and score on a 3D pinball table.

pinball.a1: Pull the plunger to launch the ball, then keep it in play with the two flippers at the bottom. Bumpers, slingshots, targets and lanes all score. You have three balls; a ball that falls between the flippers is lost.
pinball.a2: Left arrow or Z works the left flipper, right arrow or / the right one (both Shift keys work too). Hold Space or the down arrow to pull the plunger and let go to launch: the longer you hold, the harder the shot.
pinball.a3: Roll over all three lights at the top of the table to raise the multiplier by one, up to ×5. Every point after that is multiplied. Hitting all three targets on the left wall gives a big bonus.
pinball.a4: If a new ball drains within the first few seconds after you launch it, you get it back once. The status line says when a ball was saved.
pinball.q5: Can I play on my phone?
pinball.a5: Yes. Tap the left or right half of the table for the flippers, and hold the middle button to pull the plunger. Full screen gives you the biggest table. Your best score stays in this browser.

pinball.s1b: Hold Space, the down arrow or the middle button to pull the plunger, then let go.
pinball.s2b: Flip with the left and right arrows (or Z and /), or tap the two halves of the table, to send the ball back up.
pinball.s3b: Hit bumpers and targets, and light the three top lanes to raise the multiplier. Three balls per game.
